# Route

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Route`](gmeow-Route.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Route>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/connectivity`](../../slices/connectivity.md)

A traversable path through a graph of connected entities — a named, typed sequence of linked nodes with a defined start and end. Models transport lines, network paths, citation chains, social paths, and dependency chains. The actual path geometry, ordering, and cost are computed by the solver layer ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)), not asserted as triples.
